name: Go-toubun no Hanayome: Gotopazu Story 2nd
original_name: 五等分の花嫁 ごとぱずストーリー 2nd
source:
The continuation visual novel version of the franchise's online puzzle game. 
Contains 23 Gotopazu's original event stories and as well the visual novel adaptation of anime's second season.
